note: The leaf is Greek p. 44 'ΠΕΡΙ ΔΙΑΙΤΗΣ ΥΓΙΕΙΝΗΣ ... Τοὺς ἰδιώτας ὧδε χρὴ διαιτᾶσθαι', which Y reproduces; X gives an English translation page (p. 47, 'summer, that the body may become cold') from another leaf.
The leaf is p. xliii beginning '(Book III) the "discovery" is clearly identified with προδιάγνωσις', as in Y; X transcribes a different page (xlvi, 'Ariston, or Euryphon, or Phaon').
The leaf is p. 131 'ALCIBIADES I.' with Greek/Latin columns ('ΑΛ. Ἔοικεν... mum suum norit'), matching Y; X gives the Alcibiades II argumentum from p. 136, another leaf.

The leaf is badly degraded; X's opening lines ('ὁ μηδὲ χαίρειν...', 'ἁμάρτανε') fit visible traces though much of its fluent text is doubtful, while Y is almost all '<unclear>' with invented geometric words ('ὀρθὰς γωνίας', 'κἀμπύλῃ') that misrepresent the content.

Neither is reliable, but X marks its whole text '<unclear>' and catches visible words like 'ἑξάμοιρον/τριμοιρία', whereas Y falls into an invented loop repeating 'ἐν τῷ θέρει ἢ τῶν' for dozens of lines.

Y's first line ('...γραφέσθω... τῶν ζῳδίων τὸ Ζ ἡμικύκλιον'), its separate top and bottom marginalia and its 'ἐδίχασε' after the diagram fit the leaf; X's meridian text is largely invented, and it repeats the same margin note twice.
Both correctly give the Greek contents list ('Τάδε περιέχει ἐνταῦθα... ὠκέλλου φιλοσόφου περὶ τοῦ παντός'), the Latin note, '2518.' and the printed slip; the differences are only formatting.

X follows the hand more closely ('κἂν ὅλον αὐτὸ κρύψῃς', 'ὄψει πᾶσαν τὴν ἐντὸς τοῦ ἀγγείου ἐπιφάνειαν', 'ἀθροῦν... κενὸν'); Y gives the opposite sense with 'καθάπερ οὐκ ἦν' and invents 'τὸ καταλειφθὲν ἄχρι νῦν εἰς δόξαν φυλαχθὲν' and 'ἀναπλήρωσιν'.

Both reproduce 'HERONIS LIBER GEEPONICUS' and sections 1–8 ('Τίνες αἱ γενικαὶ τῶν σχημάτων διαφοραί;' ... '(V. ibid. 34)') word for word; X mixes up line numbers and section numbers in its margin tags, which is only markup.

Both give Ezekiel 1 as on the leaf; X keeps the column-1 line 'ΠΤΕΡΥΓΩΝ ΑΥΤΩΝ ΕΠΙ ΤΑ ΤΕΣΣΑΡΑ ΜΕΡΗ ΑΥΤΩΝ' that Y moves into a margin and replaces with 'ΣΥΝΑΠΤΟΜΕΝΑΙ', but X in turn drops 'ΑΥΤΟΙΣ' and garbles 'Η ΝΕΦΕΛΗ ΕΚΕΙ ΤΟ ΠΝΑ'.
